## Why it matters

The CTP Book is an open textbook for humanities students learning computational thinking and Python, with chapters, exercises, answer keys, and lab notes.

It is a solid entry point for researchers who need programming fundamentals framed for humanities teaching and digital methods rather than computer science alone.
